"Create a 3D first-person fishing game set in the middle of the ocean, on a small wooden boat. Use real 3D graphics (Three.js with a true perspective camera), not a 2D or side-view look.
Movement and camera
First-person view. Mouse or touch-drag to look around 360 degrees. On mobile, add a virtual joystick and on-screen buttons.
WASD or the joystick lets me walk around the boat deck. Keep the player on the boat.
The boat gently rocks on the waves.
Environment
Endless animated 3D ocean with moving waves, a sky with sun and clouds, and a day/night cycle.
Detailed boat with a deck, railings, and a bait box.
Fishing
Walk to the rod, press E or tap to pick it up. It appears in my hands in first person.
Hold the cast button to charge power, release to cast. The line and bobber fly out and land in the water at a distance based on power.
Wait for a bite: the bobber twitches and dips. Then tap quickly to hook the fish.
Reeling mini-game: a tension meter and a catch bar. Hold to reel, release to ease off. If tension gets too high the line snaps. Bigger fish fight harder and take longer.
Fish types (rarity and difficulty)
Small: sardine, mackerel, perch (easy, common)
Medium: tuna, snapper, bass (medium)
Large: swordfish, marlin, shark (hard, rare)
Legendary: giant squid or golden whale (very hard, very rare)
Each fish has its own size, weight, value, and strength.
Bait
Worms, shrimp, squid, glowing lure, and golden bait.
Better bait attracts bigger and rarer fish. Bait is used up on each cast.
Progression
Earn coins by selling fish. Shop to buy better rods, lines, and bait.
Inventory and a fish collection book showing everything caught.
Show a HUD with coins, current bait, and tension meter.
Polish
Water splash effects, ocean and seagull sounds, and a reel sound.
Save progress automatically.
Make sure the game is fully playable in 3D with working movement controls from the start.

## Objective
- Replace the existing 2D fishing scene with a complete, playable Three.js first-person ocean fishing game.

- Real 3D perspective; 360° mouse/touch look; WASD and mobile joystick movement constrained to the boat.
- Animated ocean, sky/day-night cycle, rocking boat, rod pickup, charged casting, bite/hook timing, tension-based reeling, fish variety, bait, shop, collection book, HUD, sounds, and autosave.

- Load Three.js from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.164.1/build/three.module.js`.

3. Summarize the finished work and note reasonable assumptions.

- `game.js`: Three.js scene, game state, fishing systems, controls, and initialization.
- `index.html`: Game HUD, controls, and modal markup.
- `style.css`: Layout and responsive/mobile/modal styles.
- `/tmp/opencode/bluewater/latest.jpg`: Latest inspected screenshot.

- Changes are uncommitted.
- `Agents.md` is also modified; that change was not part of the game work.
